notes.title: Updates and Improvements
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27982935/b1e127f89b478540d67bc6ffee42ccee7576bf79.png


Change of logo and visual identity of the game.
Changed how to present the initial story.
Removed choice of difficulties in the initial menu. Now the game has a standard difficulty.
Added pause game.
Removed hidden relics from % of game progress. Now they are just Easter Eggs.
When suffering damage, the amount of HP lost is displayed.
Created two new enemies.
Changed the layout of some phases/maps.
Added dialogs with NPCs.
Changed the music from the main menu.
Added save storage to the cloud.
Increased Kautic shot cooldown from 0.50 seconds to 0.75 seconds.
Removed/Changed the position of some enemies.
Added transactions when passing on maps.
Adjustments in screen size and positioning.
Fixed some bugs.


https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27982935/4cdbbb3c08da767f310f695ce7f456e4406c508f.png

notes.title: Updates and Improvements
notes.content:
Added Main Menu

http://badcoffeegames.com/images/steam/titulo.png

Added difficulty choices

Added options choose Easy, Normal and Hard mode which changes the amount of continue of the player..

Three new Achievements

http://badcoffeegames.com/images/steam/achievements.png

Gameplay improvements

Character now runs straight, without the need to hold a button.
Decreased cooldown of fireball shots.

Improvements in game art and history

Added some artistic details in the various maps.

New keys set to play

http://badcoffeegames.com/images/steam/controles.png

Bosses have life bar

Added bar of life in all the bosses.
